title: Palindromic Substrings
statement: Count how many substrings of s are palindromes. Substrings at different positions count separately even when they look identical.
hints: Same machinery as Longest Palindromic Substring: expand around every centre.
There are 2n-1 centres, one per character and one between each adjacent pair.
Every successful expansion step IS another palindrome, so just count the steps rather than tracking the longest.
